## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks, raw then spectral read

The raw B sweeps below are the pre-fan feasibility check. Run 6 measured region-A calibrated n=+3.2×10¹² cm⁻² at D≈0; run 7 measured n=−1.2×10¹² on the descending field leg. Both use the same hardwired B_1–B_2 pair, so either may mix two gate-offset regions.

data/7: 486 rows, B 10.000→0.300 T, R 0.4..586.9 Ω, max |X| 5.76 µV / 50 µV FS, I_drain 9.81..9.93 nA, T_sample 1.175..1.291 K, interrupted=False

from hera.analysis import resolve_channels
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11, 7))
spot = {}
for j, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r = run(rid)
    ch = {q.cid: q for q in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col('magnet_field')
    I = r.col('sr0_X') / ch['sr0'].gain
    X = r.col('sr1_X') / ch['sr1'].gain
    R = np.abs(X / I)
    spot[rid] = dict(B=B, I=I, X=X, R=R)
    a = ax[0, j]; a.plot(B, R, lw=.65)
    a.set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='|Rxx| (Ω)', title=f'data/{rid}: raw B_1–B_2')
    b = ax[1, j]
    b.plot(B, r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')*1e12, lw=.6, label='TG')
    b.plot(B, r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')*1e12, lw=.6, label='BG')
    b.set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='gate current (pA)'); b.legend()
    print(f'data/{rid}: {len(B)} rows, B {B[0]:.3f}→{B[-1]:.3f} T, '
          f'R {R.min():.1f}..{R.max():.1f} Ω, max |X| {abs(X).max()*1e6:.2f} µV / 50 µV FS, '
          f'I_drain {I.min()*1e9:.2f}..{I.max()*1e9:.2f} nA, '
          f'T_sample {r.col("T_sample").min():.3f}..{r.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K, '
          f'interrupted={r.interrupted}')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import sdh_fft
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 3.8))
for j, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    d = spot[rid]; B, R = d['B'], d['R']
    p = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[p], R[p]
    for br in ((2, 9.8), (3, 9.8), (4, 9.8)):
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=br, nfft=2048, bg_degree=4)
        y = sp[0]; pk, _ = find_peaks(y, prominence=y.max()*.06)
        peaks = [(float(f[k]), float(y[k]/y.max())) for k in pk if 2 < f[k] < 80]
        peaks = sorted(peaks, key=lambda pair: -pair[1])[:5]
        print(f'data/{rid}, B={br[0]}..{br[1]} T, ΔF≈{1/(1/br[0]-1/br[1]):.1f} T: '
              + ', '.join(f'{v:.1f} T ({a:.2f} rel.)' for v, a in peaks))
        ax[j].plot(f, y, label=f'{br[0]}–{br[1]} T')
    ax[j].set(xlim=(0, 70), xlabel='SdH frequency (T)', ylabel='FFT amplitude', title=f'data/{rid}')
    ax[j].legend(fontsize=8)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

**Read for the next step.** Both spot checks oscillate and neither rails: run 6 reaches 5.22 µV (10.4% of 50 µV full scale) and 530 Ω; run 7 reaches 5.76 µV (11.5%) and 587 Ω. Drain current remains 9.8–9.9 nA; gate-current extrema are sub-nA. The run-6 2–9.8 T FFT has prominent 7.5 and 30.1 T peaks; the high-field window concentrates around 30–34 T. Run 7 has 5.0 and 12.6 T peaks in 2–9.8 T, but the apparent peaks move strongly with the window. Harmonics, the A/B CNP offset (0.426×10¹² cm⁻² from data/5), and broad high-field features make a stacking assignment from these traces alone unsafe. A D≈0 Landau fan that crosses both CNP offsets and resolves the branch origins is the next measurement (plan step 4).

## HERA — Plan step 4: D≈0 Landau fan (`landau-fan`) across both CNP offsets

> **05:25** · Landau fan: D=0, n\_A -1.2..+3.2e12 (111), B 0..9.9 T (100), Si 0, base T, sr1 1mV, tau 0.1s, fast dwell 1s · **ETA ~10:55** (≈5h30m)

Runs 6–7 show strong, unclipped SdH oscillations (max 5.22 and 5.76 µV of 50 µV full scale), but their FFT peaks are field-window dependent and the hardwired B_1–B_2 pair includes two CNP ridges separated by 0.426×10¹² cm⁻² (data/5). A density–field fan is needed to trace branch origins and LL crossings before an ABAB/ABCA/ABCB call. Follow the data/5 calibrated D≈0 line from n_A=−1.2 to +3.2×10¹² cm⁻² (111 points, 0.04×10¹² spacing), with B slow from 0 to +9.9 T (100 rows, 0.1 T). This includes the run-7 hole spot, both CNPs, and the run-6 electron spot; the remaining −1.27 to −1.2×10¹² edge is excluded because it adds little density coverage near the TG limit. Absolute density still rests on the 9.5 nm top-hBN geometry prior; the CNP line slope and D offset are measured in data/5.

Preflight in the code checks the base-temperature logfiles, live field near zero, Si at zero with DC205 range/output, heater ranges off, magnet output/switch, lock-in drive and settling, and exact validator bounds. The 1 mV sr1 sensitivity gives ≈100 kΩ nominal headroom across the high-B CNP; sr0/sr1 τ=0.1 s with 1.0 s fast dwell gives 10τ at 24 dB/oct. A per-point guard stops on >1 nA gate leakage, sr1 reaching 90% of full scale, or temperature leaving base range. **First-rows checkpoint:** read the first 3 B rows for current, leakage, flat/dead/railed channels and field readback. **Periodic checkpoints:** inspect landed rows at ~2, 5, and 8 T for fan structure and whether clipping or unstable temperature warrants aborting; the 2D live plot is only a monitor, so re-form the partial TSV for science. Run 5 took 4873 s for 4158 gate-map points with 1 s dwell (≈1.17 s/point); 11,100 points cost ≈3 h 37 m, the 9.9 T magnet traverse costs ≥72 m at 0.137 T/min, plus 100 field settles/flybacks and contingency: ≈5 h 30 m. End at +9.9 T and the high-density gate point for the next decision.

# Plan step 4 — D≈0 density-field Landau fan across both CNP ridges.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# Card bounds are immutable this session; VERIFY cell 32 printed ALL GREEN in this kernel.
_bounds = lambda p: (float(p.vals._min_value), float(p.vals._max_value))
assert _bounds(k_tg.volt) == (-0.3, 1.0) and _bounds(k_bg.volt) == (-1.3, 2.0)
assert _bounds(dc205.smart_voltage) == (-25.0, 25.0) and _bounds(dc205.voltage) == (-25.0, 25.0)
assert _bounds(magnet.field) == (-10.0, 10.0) and B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0
assert _bounds(heater.sample_setpoint) == (0.0, 100.0) and _bounds(heater.vaporizer_setpoint) == (0.0, 100.0)

# Silent preconditions: these are inherited, not changed by this cell.
assert_thermometry_live('T_sample', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live('T_vaporizer', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_vaporizer'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T, _Tv, _B = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_Vsi, _sirange, _siout = k_si(), dc205.voltage_range(), dc205.output()
_hout = (heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range())
_drive, _freq = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()
print(f'preflight: T_sample={_T:.3f} K, T_vaporizer={_Tv:.3f} K, B={_B:+.4f} T; '
      f'Si={_Vsi:+.3f} V/range={_sirange}/out={_siout}; heater ranges={_hout}; '
      f'PS={magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, magnet output={magnet.output_enabled()}; '
      f'drive={_drive:.3f} V at {_freq:.3f} Hz; gates={k_tg.volt():+.4f}/{k_bg.volt():+.4f} V')
assert 1.0 <= _T <= 1.5 and _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_Tv - _T) < 0.6
assert abs(_B) < 0.02 and abs(_Vsi) < 0.01 and _sirange == 2 and _siout == 1
assert _hout == (0, 0) and magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert abs(_drive - 1.0) < 0.01 and abs(_freq - 13.777) < 0.01
assert sr0.filter_slope() == 24 and sr1.filter_slope() == 24
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

CAL_FAN = dict(c_tg=0.0027960593093052633, c_bg=0.002160696465377614,
               n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
n_fast = np.linspace(-1.2, 3.2, 111)  # 1e12 cm^-2, region A; includes region-B CNP at n_A=-0.426
D_fast = np.zeros_like(n_fast)          # V/nm, data/5 D-offset convention
Vtg_fast, Vbg_fast = calc_gate_voltages(n_fast, D_fast, **CAL_FAN)
B_slow = np.round(np.linspace(0.0, 9.9, 100), 4)
assert len(B_slow) * len(n_fast) == 11100 and B_slow.max() < B_SESSION_CAP
assert np.min(Vtg_fast) >= TG_MIN and np.max(Vtg_fast) <= TG_MAX
assert np.min(Vbg_fast) >= BG_MIN and np.max(Vbg_fast) <= BG_MAX
_ncheck, _Dcheck = calc_nD(Vtg_fast, Vbg_fast, **CAL_FAN)
assert np.allclose(_ncheck, n_fast) and np.max(np.abs(_Dcheck)) < 1e-9
print(f'grid: B {B_slow[0]:.1f}→{B_slow[-1]:.1f} T x n_A {n_fast[0]:+.2f}→{n_fast[-1]:+.2f}e12 '
      f'({len(B_slow)}x{len(n_fast)}); Vtg {Vtg_fast[0]:+.4f}→{Vtg_fast[-1]:+.4f} V; '
      f'Vbg {Vbg_fast[0]:+.4f}→{Vbg_fast[-1]:+.4f} V; D=0')

# Fixed sensitivity and settled fast-axis cadence; no safety or gate-pacing change.
sr0.time_constant(0.1); sr1.time_constant(0.1)
sr1.sensitivity(1e-3)  # 100 kOhm nominal full-scale at 10 nA; abort above 90%.
print(f'lock-in: sr0/sr1 tau={sr0.time_constant()}/{sr1.time_constant()} s, '
      f'sr1 sens={sr1.sensitivity():g} V, sr0 sens={sr0.sensitivity():g} V')

mc = dict(meas_config)
mc['Si (V)'] = _Vsi
mc['sample_temperature:'] = _T
mc['comments'] = ('landau-fan: D=0 from data/5; n_A -1.2..+3.2e12 cm^-2 x111; '
                  'B 0..+9.9 T x100; Vtg/Vbg co-swept; sr1 1mV, tau 0.1s, fast_delay 1s')
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('B slow 0..+9.9 T (100 x 0.1 T); n_A fast -1.2..+3.2e12 cm^-2 '
              '(111 x 0.04e12), D=0 via data/5 calibration; Si=0; sr1 sensitivity 1mV; '
              'sr0/sr1 tau 0.1s; 1s fast dwell; hardwired B_1-B_2; two CNP origins n_A=0,-0.426e12')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_fast[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_fast[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# multimegasweep rows: time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T, I_tg, I_bg, sr0_X, sr0_P, sr1_X, sr1_P.
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
for _channel in (T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P):
    s.plot('time', _channel)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    x1, t = abs(float(data[9])), float(data[4])
    if i_tg > 1e-9 or i_bg > 1e-9 or x1 > 0.9e-3 or not (1.0 <= t <= 1.6):
        print(f'FAN STOP B={float(data[1]):.2f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V: '
              f'|I_tg/bg|={i_tg:.2e}/{i_bg:.2e} A, |sr1_X|={x1*1e6:.1f} uV, T={t:.3f} K')
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_slow], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt],
                 [Vtg_fast, Vbg_fast], slow_delay=0, fast_delay=1.0)
print(f'fan ended: measured B={magnet.field():+.4f} T; gates '
      f'Vtg={k_tg.volt():+.4f}, Vbg={k_bg.volt():+.4f}, Si={k_si():+.4f} V; '
      f'T_sample={T_sample():.3f} K')

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
